note: Identity of the user-supplied game data this project supports (M27, D-059). Hashes, sizes and header fields only; no game content. content_id = SHA-1 of the XContent header from 0x344 to the 4 KiB-aligned header size: it covers the metadata and the STFS volume descriptor (top hash table hash) but not the licence entries or the signature, so it identifies the release independently of the purchaser. observed_package_sha256 is the one dump this project was developed from; another owner's package of the same release may differ in its licence block and signature.
